text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, so?! Are you shocked, Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I certainly am. My goodness, but you
really are
outrageous!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, your ability to pull off feats
like this is
testament to your true
strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're outrageous, you show interest in
anything
and everything... and yet, you
don't let on to
what truly is going
through your head.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If nothing else, I wanted to beat you and
force
you to voice your true feelings
today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I haven't given up. I can't very well walk
my ideal
path while I remain bested by
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We'll race again, Fine. I won't take no
for an
answer. I expect you've come to
terms with
leaving, but there's still some
time before you do,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove... Yes, I'll definitely consider it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but this is your petition to challenge
me,
right? In that case, could I add a
condition?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When we get back to the academy, I
want you to
take me to the ramen shop
you think is best!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whichever one you like is fine by me.
Would that
be all right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I'll mull it over until I find
somewhere
that'll turn your entire
perception of ramen
upside-down.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Excellent, I can't wait! ♪ And if you're
going
looking for ramen shops, I'll come
with you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That would make the whole thing
pointless!
...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness! There's a call from your
sister.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Y-your sister?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's older sister is an
exceptional
Umamusume who is
currently competing all over
the globe. I
know her only by reputation.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Her Highness wishes to speak with Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Air Groove is her favorite.
Do you
mind, Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't put her through! Tell her I've
already gone
home!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear... I'm terribly sorry, Captain,
but could
you tell my sister that Groove
is unavailable?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
...Um, actually, she said she'd like to
speak to
your trainer instead if that were
to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Yes, hello there? Are you the trainer
responsible
for my dear little princess?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Are you frightened? That's a shame—I
prefer
strong-willed types. One must
hold back when
dealing with the meek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first impression of Fine Motion's
sister is that
she has a... unique
personality.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
A let-down to be sure, but I don't doubt
you can
get the job done. Now, let's get
to the heart of
the matter.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
There's something I absolutely must say
to you.
And that is... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
I made the decision to pursue a racing
career
from an early age. As such, my
dear sister was left
to shoulder the
duties I left behind.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
She would claim she shoulders them of
her own
volition, but deep down, I've
always harbored
some guilt—I essentially
locked that innocent
young girl away in
the castle by my own hand.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Which is why, now, seeing her running so
freely in
Japan... I feel a weight lifted
from my own
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for enabling her to express
her true
feelings and explore the wider
world.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
I trust you'll continue to take good care
of her in
the future as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, what is she saying? Can I hear?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, is that the chirping of my little
dove I hear?
Could you put Fine Motion
on?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hello, dear sister! Thank you for that
passionate
letter you sent the other day.
It was very
touching.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Mere words hardly sufficed to capture
my love for
you... Oh! I've finally
succeeded in running half
the world's
circumference.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I never doubted you for a
moment! Were
those spots on the paper
from sweat, then? I
thought perhaps you
had spilled some tea.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Why, they were from the tears I shed
longing for
your company, of course.
...Though, there might
be some Assam
tea mixed in there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This peculiar back and forth between
Fine Motion
and her sister continues for
some time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we can return to summer camp
from
Hokkaido, something unexpected
occurs.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Fine! Is it true that you're quitting
racing?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Captain?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
...I've confirmed the situation. It appears
that
information pertaining to our recent
meeting about your
return home
somehow leaked.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...
Well, I suppose the truth was going to
get out
eventually.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's true. After this year, I will be
returning to
Ireland to carry out my
official duties.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
No way!
You mean we'll never get to see
you race again?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I am truly grateful for all the support
and
encouragement you've given me
until now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have... one last request for you all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please do watch my final race. I would
like to—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: No. I definitely will carve a space for myself in your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So please... Will you come watch me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll be holding a press conference to
provide
further details. For now...
farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps stunned by Fine Motion's
sincerity, the
fans watch in silence as we
leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the summer
campgrounds, I
decide that now is the
time to speak to Fine
Motion about her
next race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I know.
choice_data_list: 最後のレースになるかもしれない
choice_data_list_en: This might be the final race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've taken the time and rank of the races
into
consideration and, more
importantly, I've
weighed them by
whether the opponents might
make her
last race a truly enjoyable one.
choice_data_list: 候補のレースを4本まで絞ったよ
choice_data_list_en: I narrowed down the candidate races to four.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've landed on the autumn Tenno Sho,
the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup, the Mile
Championship, and the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ... Just checking, but... theoretically, I could enter all of them, couldn't I?
choice_data_list: 貴方の意見を聞きたい
choice_data_list_en: I'd like to hear your opinion.
I want to hear your opinion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's just that you'd like me to choose one
final
race to take on in peak condition?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Could I have a little time to think
about it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
One day should be enough. I just need
to... sort
out my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she plans to shoulder this
decision
alone again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to have faith and leave things in
her
hands.
choice_data_list: （いや、きっとそうはならない）
